statement: >= 15 distinct organisations with a >= 1e26 FLOP run (shared with I-N-01; counted once per family 'holders') (Epoch AI; 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Same evidence as I-N-01 (family 'holders', counted once): Epoch lists 4 models above 1e26 FLOP from 2 organisations, both Bloc A; floor rather than ceiling because several flagships lack estimates. Far below 15. Items below share cluster keys with I-N-01 and must not be double-counted.

items.summary: Annual AI index notes leading Bloc A developers stopped reporting training compute; threshold counts from public data are estimates and lower bounds. (Duplicate of I-N-01-001.)

The leading Bloc B open-weight flagship of spring 2026 was estimated at ~1e25 FLOP, an order of magnitude below 1e26; diffusion of 1e26-scale runs beyond Bloc A not observed. (Duplicate of I-N-01-002.)
items.detail: DeepSeek-V4-Pro ~9.7e24 FLOP (Epoch 'Likely' per AI Wiki; DatacentersX). cluster: CL-2026-04-deepseek-v4-compute.

items.summary: A Bloc B open-weight model released mid-2026 was given a speculative estimate of ~2e25 FLOP; no non-Bloc-A organisation is known above 1e26.
items.detail: Moonshot AI Kimi K3 (Jul 2026), ~2e25 speculative, DatacentersX frontier runs table. Release day approximate.

items.summary: Epoch AI's database holds 4 notable models above 1e26 FLOP from only 2 distinct organisations (both Bloc A) after adding the Sept 2026 record run. (Duplicate of I-N-01-004.)
items.detail: GPT-6 Astra 9.4e26, GPT-4.5 (OpenAI); Grok 4, Grok 3 (xAI). cluster: CL-2026-10-15-epoch-astra.

items.summary: At least three more Bloc A developers' flagships are likely above 1e26 but lack Epoch estimates; even counting them the total would be ~5 organisations, well short of 15. (Duplicate of I-N-01-006.)
items.detail: Google (Gemini 3/4), Anthropic (Claude), Meta (Muse) undisclosed. cluster: CL-2026-10-undisclosed-1e26.
